模块名：ring_lsp::asset_indexer
功能：扫描项目 assets/ 目录，建立资源索引

类型：
- AssetIndex：包含 entries (BTreeMap<String, AssetEntry>) 和 by_type (BTreeMap<AssetType, Vec<String>>)
- AssetEntry：包含 absolute_path (PathBuf)、relative_path (String)、file_size (u64)、asset_type (AssetType)
- AssetType 枚举：Image, Audio, Video, Script, Other

公开方法：
- AssetIndex::new() -> Self
- AssetIndex::scan(root: &Path) -> Result<Self, io::Error>：递归扫描目录
- AssetIndex::lookup(&self, relative_path: &str) -> Option<&AssetEntry>
- AssetIndex::by_type(&self, asset_type: AssetType) -> &[String]
- AssetIndex::update_file(&mut self, path: &Path, event: FileEvent)：增量更新
- FileEvent 枚举：Created, Modified, Deleted

要求：
- 使用 std::path::Path/PathBuf
- derive Debug, Clone 在适当的类型上
- 公开 API 添加简短文档注释（中文）
- 输出纯 Rust 代码，不要额外解释

[workspace]
resolver = "3"

members = [
    "vn-runtime",
    "host-dioxus",
    "tools/asset-packer",
    "tools/xtask",
]

default-members = ["host-dioxus"]

[workspace.dependencies]
# ── 序列化 ──
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"

# ── 错误处理 ──
thiserror = "2"
anyhow = "1"

# ── CLI / 工具 ──
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
walkdir = "2.5"
xshell = "0.2"
zip = { version = "8", default-features = false }

# ── 内部 crate ──
vn-runtime = { path = "vn-runtime" }

# ── 测试 ──
insta = { version = "1", features = ["yaml"] }

[workspace.lints.clippy]
# ── pedantic 组（priority -1 让单项覆盖生效） ──
pedantic = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
module_name_repetitions = "allow"
must_use_candidate = "allow"
missing_errors_doc = "allow"
missing_panics_doc = "allow"
too_many_lines = "allow"

unused_self = "allow"
float_cmp = "allow"
cast_possible_truncation = "allow"
cast_precision_loss = "allow"
cast_sign_loss = "allow"

# ── restriction 精选 ──

expect_used = "warn"
dbg_macro = "warn"
print_stdout = "warn"
print_stderr = "warn"
string_slice = "warn"
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "warn"
allow_attributes_without_reason = "warn"
allow_attributes = "warn"
panic = "warn"

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
unreachable_pub = "warn"

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 1

[profile.release]
debug = true

[profile.test]
debug = "none"

[profile.mutants]
inherits = "test"
debug = "none"
